sections.heading: O događaju
paragraphs: Advent u Zmijavcima okuplja mještane i goste iz cijele Imotske krajine. Središte mjesta zasja pod lampicama, a oko klizališta, šatora i adventskih kućica druži se cijela obitelj. Prošle je godine naš advent osvojio 1. mjesto na izboru za najljepši advent u Hrvatskoj u kategoriji općina. Naša pozornica nije samo mjesto nastupa, ona je simbol pjesme i radosti.

programme.heading: Program
notes: I ove godine advent ima bogat koncertni program, a svaka večer ima svoju priču i našeg resident DJ 43EVER.
Uz koncertni program, klizalište će biti otvoreno svakog dana od 16 sati.

en.title: Advent in Zmijavci
en.summary: An ice rink, Advent stalls and time together for the whole family under thousands of lights.
en.lead: From 18 December to 2 January, the centre of Zmijavci turns into a winter fairy tale — concerts, an ice rink, Advent stalls and thousands of lights.
en.description: Advent in Zmijavci, 18 December to 2 January: free concerts, an ice rink, Advent stalls and thousands of lights. Most Beautiful Advent in Croatia 2025/2026 in the municipality category.

sections.heading: About the event
paragraphs: Advent in Zmijavci brings together locals and visitors from across the Imotski region. The village centre glows under the lights, and the whole family gathers around the ice rink, the marquee and the Advent stalls. Last year, our Advent won first place in the municipality category of the Most Beautiful Advent in Croatia selection. Our stage is more than a place to perform: it is a symbol of song and joy.

award.imageAlt: Most Beautiful Advent in Croatia 2025/2026 award for Advent in Zmijavci
award.title: Most Beautiful Advent in Croatia
award.text: Advent in Zmijavci won first place in the municipality category of the 2025/2026 Most Beautiful Advent in Croatia selection by the Načelnik.hr portal.

programme.heading: Programme
notes: Once again this year, Advent has a rich concert programme, and every night has its own story, along with our resident DJ 43EVER.
Alongside the concerts, the ice rink will be open every day from 4 pm.
